He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.

sections.heading: Mithun Chakraborty — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mithun Chakraborty was born on 16 June 1950 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality.

paras: His professional record lists film actor and politician as his occupations.
